# Kbd > Keyboard shortcut chip and chord group. This file matches the installed `kbd` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/kbd.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/kbd.md`. ## Registry dependencies - `core` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/kbd-knobs`: `kbdKnobs`, types `KbdKnobStyle` - `@/components/control-ui/ui/kbd`: `kbdVariants`, `Kbd`, `KbdGroup`, types `KbdVariant`, `KbdProps`, `KbdGroupProps` ## Composition ### Keyboard chord ```tsx ``` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { Kbd, KbdGroup } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/kbd"; import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography"; export function PrimitiveKbdExample() { return (
Single key Esc
Command palette ⌘ K
Send message ⌘ ↵
Inline hint ⌘K
); } ``` ## Anatomy Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`. - `kbd` - `group` - `root`: `data-variant` (`default` | `ghost`) ## Knobs Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin. ### kbd - `--cui-kbd-radius`: `var(--radius-control)` - `--cui-kbd-background`: `oklch(from var(--card) l c h / 0.6)` - `--cui-kbd-foreground`: `var(--muted-foreground)` - `--cui-kbd-border-color`: `var(--control-rim)` - `--cui-kbd-shadow`: `var(--shadow-sm)` - `--cui-kbd-padding-inline`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 1.5)` - `--cui-kbd-font-size`: `var(--text-micro)` - `--cui-kbd-font-weight`: `var(--font-weight-medium)` ## Links - Online docs (latest release): https://control-ui.dev/components/kbd - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/kbd.json
